title: The SEGASLAYER64 resouce pack
description:
For the SUPER DUPER SEGASLAYER64 MODPACK

Made to be used with the BMO Companions resource pack.
body: This is a simple resource pack made for SEGASLAYER64. It includes all paintings (except one, left in becuase it is nice) being replaced. The Title and version changed to fit pack, the main menu screen changed to SEGASLAYER64's world. And all dog sounds replaced with BMO sounds since the mod pack is intended to be used with the BMO companion resource pack, by Super_Jose.
